name: agentq
description: Capacity-aware dispatcher for coding agents: quota, model scores and a task queue, exposed over MCP, backed by a local subscription ROI tracker.

scripts.lint: biome check src/ test/ testdata/ bin/ scripts/ docs/*.md biome.json package.json tsconfig.json README.md justfile --no-errors-on-unmatched --files-ignore-unknown=true
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && bash -n pi-issue.sh pi-task.sh claude-issue.sh claude-task.sh pi-workflow.sh bin/*.sh .agents/skills/agentq/scripts/*.sh && npm test && npm run verify:fixtures
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run build:fixtures
scripts.ci:isolated: fixture_home=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$fixture_home"' EXIT && cp -R testdata/home/. "$fixture_home/" && AGENTQ_HOME="$fixture_home" AGENTQ_FIXTURE_HOME="$fixture_home" npm run ci
scripts.build:fixtures: AGENTQ_HOME=${AGENTQ_FIXTURE_HOME:-testdata/home} node src/roi-tracker/pipeline.js && AGENTQ_HOME=${AGENTQ_FIXTURE_HOME:-testdata/home} node src/roi-tracker/render-html.js && AGENTQ_HOME=${AGENTQ_FIXTURE_HOME:-testdata/home} node src/roi-tracker/export-csv.js
scripts.build: npm run pipeline && npm run render && npm run export-csv
scripts.clean: rm -f data/roi-output.json data/ccagg-by-model.csv data/ccagg-by-model-path.csv data/ccagg-daily.csv docs/roi-dashboard.html
scripts.docker-restart: docker compose down && docker compose up --build -d
